_about: Help translations into English of the Norwegian texts the demo jobs can show. Written by the builder so that readers who do not read Norwegian can follow the demo. They are not part of any SJA, are never sent to a model, and are not checked by the language check. Template lines are not listed here: their English comes from the template itself.

texts.Vi skal løfte 6 bunter med takstoler opp: We are lifting 6 bundles of roof trusses up onto the roof. The lift goes over the walkway at the entrance, and the load is long and catches the wind.
texts.Vi skal skifte takrenner på østsiden. De: We are replacing gutters on the east side. There is an opening in the floor by the stairs, and the scaffold stands out towards the pavement.
texts.Skal heise opp noen paller m gips t 3 et: Gonna hoist some pallets w plasterboard to 3rd floor, using the forklift. Bit tight at the gate, might have to take it over the fence?? sorting the strap myself
texts.Vi skal montere takvinduer. Noen må ut p: We are fitting roof windows. Someone has to go out on the roof outside the scaffold. We hoist the windows up with a winch.
texts.Løfte ventilasjonsaggregat opp på tak me: Lifting a ventilation unit onto a roof with a lorry loader crane. The crane has to stand in the street, and a power line runs along the pavement.
texts.Maling av fasade fra rullestillas. Under: Painting a facade from a mobile scaffold. The ground is gravel and slightly sloping, and we have to move the scaffold several times.
Replacing a light fitting in a stairwell from a ladder. Short job, but the floor is freshly polished and slippery.
texts.Lossing av armeringsnett fra bil med tel: Unloading reinforcement mesh from a lorry with a telehandler. Many people in the area because the concrete truck arrives at the same time.
Lifting 6 bundles of roof trusses up onto the roof.
The lift goes over the walkway at the entrance.
The load is long and exposed to wind.
Replacing gutters on the east side.
There is an opening in the floor by the stairs.
The scaffold stands out towards the pavement.
texts.Løft av paller med gipsplater til 3. eta: Lifting pallets of plasterboard to the 3rd floor.
texts.Trang plass ved porten. Lasten tas gjenn: Little room at the gate. The load goes through the gate, not over the fence.
texts.Uklart om lasten skal løftes over gjerde: Unclear whether the load is to be lifted over the fence or taken through the gate.
texts.Uklart hvem som kontrollerer løftestropp: Unclear who checks the lifting slings before use.
Work on the roof outside the scaffold.
The windows are hoisted up with a winch.
texts.Skal lasten løftes over gjerdet, eller t: Is the load to be lifted over the fence, or taken through the gate?
texts.Hva betyr «fikser stroppa selv»? Hvem ko: What does “sorting the strap myself” mean? Who checks the lifting slings before use?
texts.Anhukeren kontrollerer løftestroppene fø: The slinger checks the lifting slings before use
The slinger checks the lifting slings before use.
texts.De er ikke kontrollert ennå: They have not been checked yet
texts.Ikke løft over gangveien mens personer o: Do not lift over the walkway while people are on it.
texts.Sperr av faresonen rundt løftet, også ga: Cordon off the danger zone around the lift, including the walkway at the entrance.
texts.Sperr av faresonen rundt løftet og hold: Cordon off the danger zone around the lift and keep the gate closed during the lift.
Use two tag lines because the load is long.
texts.Sperr av fortauet under stillaset før ar: Cordon off the pavement below the scaffold before work starts.
texts.Sperr av fortauet under stillaset før de: Cordon off the pavement below the scaffold before you begin.
texts.Utsparingen i dekket ved trappa skal dek: The opening in the floor by the stairs must be covered and marked.
texts.Alle som går opp på stillaset skal ha få: Everyone who goes up the scaffold must have been trained.
texts.Bruk fallsikringssele festet til forankr: Use a fall-arrest harness attached to an anchor point the whole time you are outside the scaffold.
texts.Vinsjen skal ha lastbrems og være festet: The winch must have a load brake and be fixed to a load-bearing structure.
texts.Anhukeren sperrer av faresonen rundt løf: The slinger cordons off the danger zone around the lift with barrier tape before the lift starts.
